say:3:1536003001:0.text: Have you all had enough to eat? Got warm clothes to wear?
say:3:1536003001:0.source_cn: 你们最近吃得饱吗，穿得暖吗？

say:4:1536003002:0.text: How do you feel about Halia these days? Like it? If not, what's wrong with it?
say:4:1536003002:0.source_cn: 你们觉得呼临城现在怎么样，喜欢这里吗？如果不太喜欢的话...

say:5:1536003003:0.text: Really, don't hold back. Just say whatever pops into your head. I'm not taking notes or anything!
say:5:1536003003:0.source_cn: 随便说，千万别想多！我就是随便问问，问着玩玩的！

say:6:1536003004:0.text: What's with this kid and all these weird questions? What's he really up to?
say:6:1536003004:0.source_cn: 这个孩子问的问题怎么都这么奇怪？他到底是来干什么的？

say:7:1536003005:0.text: Probably some rich kid playing pretend, trying to see how us common folk live.
say:7:1536003005:0.source_cn: 估计是哪个有钱家的孩子，对我们生活好奇呗，有没什么的。

say:8:1536003006:0.text: All you have to do is complain, and he doesn't fight back—just shoves bread at you! Look, half a loaf, right here!
say:8:1536003006:0.source_cn: 你有什么不满的直接说出来，这孩子不仅不反驳你，还给你送...

say:9:1536003007:0.text: Why are you all staring? Got something to say too?
say:9:1536003007:0.source_cn: 你们怎么一直看着我，是不是也想提建议？

say:10:1536003008:0.text: Ahem! Go on, speak your mind. Don't be shy!
say:10:1536003008:0.source_cn: 咳嗯！大胆地说出你的意见吧！

narration:12:1536003009:0.text: You can't help but smile. Abundius is still dead serious in his disguise, unaware he'd already been found out.
narration:12:1536003009:0.source_cn: 看着眼前浑然不知自己已经被发现，还在一本正经伪装着的阿...
narration:12:1536003009:0.male: You can't help but smile. Abundius is still dead serious in his disguise, unaware he'd already been found out.
narration:12:1536003009:0.female: You can't help but smile. Abundius is still dead serious in his disguise, unaware he'd already been found out.
